answer: The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, capped per identity per epoch, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Reaching the nectar of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Work waits on the tundra until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the shale of the next round. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
